verdict.rationale: Zero is a self-hostable AI email app, so official SDKs are a fair question for it, but the evidence never mentions any official SDK or client library. The only programmatic surface is an MCP server described in prose (MCP.md) with session-cookie auth. An independent probe notes there is no documented public HTTP API and no docs site, and MCP-server evidence belongs to a different story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
